messages:
oncall-bot: ALERT: INC-20277 detected — embeddings latency spike in eu-west-1. Pager sent to SRE rotation. If you're on-call please ack.

ana: acked. I'm looking at the inference cluster now, seeing tail latencies on p4d nodes.

mike: noted. I'll take real-time routing. Can we get a quick customer-impact blurb we can translate and schedule per region?

liam: high priority for customer comms. For status page/email we should avoid technical jargon — focus on what customers see, ETA for mitigation, and regions affected.

sara: support queue already getting tickets from EU customers. Short notice in native languages would reduce duplicate tickets. We need translations for EN, FR, ES, DE, JA.

eva: I can produce quick translated blurbs. Prefer short SMS-style messages for pager and slightly richer copy for status page. Who will own send times?

mike: ops-bot can handle scheduled sends once we provide content + timezone mapping. Ops, is that correct?

ops-bot: yes — ops-bot can schedule per-region notices. Provide payloads with keys: region, send_time_utc, channel(list), content. Example schema accepted.

ana: mitigation update: rolling restart of inference workers in eu-west-1 reduced 95p by ~40%. Still monitoring. ETA for full stabilization ~30–45m.

liam: good. Draft for status page (EN):
```
We are investigating increased latency for embeddings in eu-west-1. Some requests may experience delays. Engineers are rolling workers and we expect service levels to recover within 30–60 minutes. We will post updates here and via email.
```

sara: customer-facing short note (EN) for email/SMS: "We’re aware of delays affecting embeddings in EU-West. Our team is working on a fix — normal service expected within 1 hour. More updates on status.redwood.ai."

mike: here's the per-region send schedule proposal (local delivery times chosen to minimize business-hour confusion):
- NA (us-east/us-west): send immediately and repeat at 30m if unresolved (UTC offsets: 14:00 UTC / 07:00 PDT)
- EU (eu-west-1): send immediately (mitigation ongoing) and a follow-up at 45m (UTC offsets: 14:00 UTC / 15:00 CET)
- APAC (ap-northeast-1 / ap-south-1): send localized notice 1 hour after stabilization window begins to avoid alarming local on-call; if not stabilized, send at scheduled 60m (UTC offsets: 23:00 UTC / 08:00 JST)

eva: translations ready (quick pass):
- FR: "Nous rencontrons des latences accrues pour les embeddings en eu-west-1. Une équipe intervient, rétablissement prévu sous 1 heure."
- ES: "Estamos detectando retrasos en embeddings en eu-west-1. Nuestro equipo trabaja en una solución; servicio normal esperado en 1 hora."
- DE: "In eu-west-1 treten erhöhte Latenzen bei Embeddings auf. Unser Team arbeitet an einer Lösung — Wiederherstellung innerhalb einer Stunde erwartet."
- JA: "eu-west-1で埋め込みの遅延が発生しています。エンジニアが対応中で、1時間以内に復旧する見込みです。"

ana: add a short internal blurb for on-call handoff and slack thread to include with status page update:
```
Internal: Incident INC-20277 — embeddings latency spike in eu-west-1. Rolling restarts in progress. Current owner: ana (SRE). Estimated recovery: 30–60m. Escalation: mike (SRE lead). Next update: +30m or on state change.
```

liam: customer-facing subject lines per region (short):
- EN: "Service delay affecting embeddings in EU-West"
- FR: "Retard de service — embeddings (EU-West)"
- ES: "Retraso del servicio — embeddings (EU-West)"

sara: please include a short CTA in emails: "If this impacts your SLA-critical workflows, reply and we’ll prioritize a direct update." That helps triage.

mike: ops-bot, format payloads and run schedule using these UTC send times:
```json
[{"region":"eu","send_time_utc":"1772004600","channels":["status_page","email","sms"],"lang":"fr,es,de,en,ja","content_id":"INC-20277-status-v1"}]
```
(we'll convert human times to epoch for the scheduler)

ops-bot: acknowledged. Will schedule immediate dispatch for EU and NA. APAC will be queued for +60m and gated on stabilization flag.

eva: small note on localization tone — FR/DE should be slightly more formal, JA should be concise. I've adjusted copy accordingly and uploaded to the translation deck (link: https://docs.redwood.ai/incident-translations/INC-20277).

ana: rolling restarts finished on 3/rd wave, 95p latency now within SLO. Monitoring for 20m before closing.

liam: thanks. Once monitoring window passes, ops-bot please post resolved update with short closure blurb and link to postmortem template.

ops-bot: will post resolved notice: "INC-20277 — Resolved in eu-west-1. Services returned to normal. Full postmortem scheduled." Scheduling localized resolved notices in EN/FR/ES/DE/JA at same mapping.

sara: support informed. I'll send a canned reply for open tickets linking to status page + localized closure blurb.

eva: I’ll prep a 1-paragraph postmortem intro in each language for the external status page to speed publishing.

mike: final checklist before we close thread: update status page, send localized resolved email, create postmortem draft, update on-call rotation logs. If anything else, call it out now.

ana: updating status page now. Closing thread after verification window. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
